verdict.rationale: Swell documents a Backend API, with pages on authentication, products, stock and purchase links, and official Node/PHP libraries. Nothing in the evidence describes an interactive API explorer or runnable in-browser examples, and probes for an OpenAPI spec at common paths all returned 404. A static reference and client libraries are adjacent to an interactive reference, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
